test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate 'one word' for the expression given below.

A person who can speak multiple languages.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2' **i.e.** 'Polyglot'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is 2) **"Polyglot".**
 
• A **"Polyglot"** is a person who knows and is able to use several languages.(बहुभ
